nodes.name: Error Trigger
nodes.notes: n8n calls this automatically whenever a workflow that names this one as its Settings -> Error Workflow fails. Payload fields used below (execution.id/url/error.message/error.node.name, workflow.id/name) verified against a live n8n execution, not assumed from docs.

nodes.name: Shape the report
nodes.notes: Feeds the MCP Client node's JSON input mode below, which references $json.subject / $json.body directly.

nodes.name: Tell Anton
nodes.notes:
The public auth-gate (port 3080) is a cookie-session login page, not a bearer-token API door -- confirmed live, a valid Bearer header gets the login HTML back regardless. This calls Anton's SEPARATE MCP surface instead (anton mcp --transport http --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8877 --token <ANTON_DASHBOARD_TOKEN>), which does real per-request bearer auth and is what n8n's MCP Client node already speaks (see anton-mcp-client.json). anton_report_failure classifies through the SAME inbox loop /api/inbox/messages uses; the ACTION REQUIRED subject text is what earns kind=flag (inbox.py's _RULE_FLAG) -- ungated, synchronous, visible at GET /api/inbox/queue?stream=flags. It can never reach kind=send: nothing here asks Anton to reply to anyone, so the outbound gate never engages.

Credential 'Anton header auth' (HTTP Header Auth): Name=Authorization, Value=Bearer <ANTON_DASHBOARD_TOKEN>. Set ANTON_MCP_URL if Anton is not reachable at the container name 'anton' on this n8n instance's network.
